design_reference: Editeur Livre-Jeu - Wireframes.dc.html § 02 « Éditeur — vue d'ensemble de l'arbre » (the BINDING target: top bar with book title + node count + « + Nœud »; dot-grid canvas; node cards with NodeBadge + ref + title + 1-line snippet; SVG connectors with arrowheads + mono edge labels; the dashed-curve « fuite » relink edge; bottom-right zoom controls) and § 06 for how new/relink edges read on the canvas. Node marks come from foundations/badges-nodes.html; cards/badges/tokens from styles.css. Low-fi, light theme.

plan.goal: Render the book as a navigable graph of node cards and labelled edges on a dot-grid canvas, with selection, pan/zoom, and the entry point to add a node — the primary editor surface.

design_contract._binding: Rebuild § 02 with design-system components only; DS tokens win over prose. No new px scales — reuse the wireframe's card/badge/connector anatomy.
design_contract.topbar: Left: « ← Mes livres » + divider + book title (--fs-title/700) + a muted node-count `Badge`. Right: « Aperçu du jeu ▷ » (ghost, opens game-preview — play mode, out of editor scope) + « + Nœud » (accent primary).
design_contract.canvas: Flat var(--surface-card) inset with a dot-grid background (radial-gradient(var(--paper-2/E3E3E0) 1px, transparent 1px) at 22px). Nodes are absolutely-positioned cards: `surfaces/Card` shrunk, header row = `NodeBadge` (kind) + mono ref (#n) right-aligned, then title (--fs-body/600) + 1-line clamped snippet (--fs-meta, --text-faint). Selected node = accent border + var(--ring-selected).
design_contract.edges: SVG lines with a shared arrowhead marker (var(--ink) ramp); a `choice` edge is solid, a `relink`/`fuite` edge is dashed (stroke-dasharray 6 5, --ink-5) and may curve. Each edge carries a mono label chip (the choice text) centered on the line.
design_contract.controls: Bottom-right vertical zoom +/− on white var(--r-md) buttons. A view-mode switch (canvas ↔ outline) lives in the top bar, backed by UIPreferencesService (not synced).
design_contract.empty_state: A freshly created book shows the seeded Sommaire + isolated Mort; the « + Nœud » and the dashed « + Première feuille » affordance (wireframe § 01 step 3) invite the first authoring action (project-wide empty-state rule).

acceptance_criteria: The canvas renders one card per node and one edge per relationship, read live from BookService; adding/removing/renaming a node or edge elsewhere updates the canvas without reload (driven by node:* / edge:* events).
Each node card shows its type via the correct NodeBadge mark (sommaire/choix/pnj/decor/piege/monstre/fin/mort), its ref, its title, and a 1-line snippet of its description.
Clicking a node selects it (accent border + ring) and emits node:selected{nodeId}; exactly one node is selected at a time; clicking empty canvas clears selection.
`choice` edges render solid and `relink`/`fuite` edges render dashed; every edge shows its choice-label chip; the obligatory Mort node is reachable only via authored edges (never auto-connected).
The canvas pans (drag) and zooms (controls + wheel/trackpad) smoothly; pan/zoom and the canvas↔outline view mode persist per book via UIPreferencesService and are NOT pushed to cloud sync.
« + Nœud » creates a new unattached node through BookService and selects it; the seeded empty book still shows Sommaire + Mort with an inviting affordance to author the first leaf.

Node positions are persisted (via BookService/PersistenceService) so the layout is stable across reloads; a node with no stored position gets a deterministic auto-layout slot rather than overlapping at 0,0.
Selecting a node here is what opens node-editor's side panel (via node:selected) — the canvas owns selection, not editing.
All chrome renders from design-system tokens/components, light theme; node cards stay legible at the default zoom (title ≥ --fs-body).
plan.walking_skeleton: Read the open book from BookService, lay nodes out (stored position or auto-layout), draw cards + SVG edges on a static dot-grid. Click a card → emit node:selected (the side panel reacts). Wire node:*/edge:* listeners to re-render. No pan/zoom polish, no curved edges yet — just a faithful static graph with live selection.

iterations.goal: Faithful static render of § 02: cards with correct NodeBadge marks, refs, titles, snippets; solid/dashed SVG edges with arrowheads and centered label chips; top bar; zoom controls (visual). Design-system fidelity pass.

Live data binding: render from BookService; subscribe to node:* / edge:* to update incrementally; « + Nœud » creates+selects a node; selection emits node:selected and is single-select with clear-on-empty-click.

Pan/zoom + layout persistence: drag-pan, wheel/control zoom, deterministic auto-layout for position-less nodes, persisted positions + per-book view state via UIPreferencesService (not cloud-synced, KR-022).
Robustness at scale: virtualize / cull off-screen nodes for large books, avoid edge-label overlap, keep 60fps pan; guard against orphaned edges referencing deleted nodes (KR-021).

known_risks: KR-020 — The canvas is a VIEW, not the model: never mutate node/edge data locally; all changes go through BookService so outline-view and game-preview stay consistent. Local-only edits desync the two visualizations.
KR-021 — Orphaned edges: an edge whose source/target node was deleted must be dropped or visibly flagged, never rendered as a line to nowhere or a crash. Reconcile on every node:deleted.

KR-022 — Pan/zoom and view-mode are UI preferences (UIPreferencesService), explicitly NOT part of the synced book document; pushing them to CloudSyncService would cause spurious conflicts (re-asserts cloud-first boundary).

KR-023 — Node positions belong to the book document and must persist; position-less nodes use a top-down tidy-tree layout placed under the first-authored parent (no random scatter, no 0,0 pileup) so reopening a book is stable.
KR-024 — Selection is owned here and broadcast via node:selected; node-editor must not also own a competing selection source (single source of truth, avoids two-panel desync).
KR-011 — No raw window.localStorage; positions/view-state persist only through PersistenceService/UIPreferencesService (global config KR-111).
KR-013 — Derive layout/selection state inline or in event handlers, not via useEffect-synced mirrors of props (global config KR-113).
Perf — large books (100+ nodes) must cull off-screen rendering and keep pan/zoom at 60fps; SVG edge count is the usual bottleneck.
A11y — node cards are keyboard-focusable and selectable; the canvas is not a keyboard trap; provide a non-pointer path to select/pan for accessibility.

resolved_decisions: Editor scope only: « Aperçu du jeu ▷ » navigates to the play/book-launch mode, which is out of this feature's scope.
Canvas owns node selection (single source of truth); node-editor reacts to node:selected.
Pan/zoom + canvas↔outline view mode are local UI preferences, not synced.

Auto-layout for position-less nodes is a top-down tidy-tree (matching the chosen wireframe § 02 layout): each node is placed under its FIRST-authored parent, and relink/fuite edges are drawn as secondary dashed arrows over that layout.
« + Nœud » creates a FREE-FLOATING unattached node (then selected for editing); attaching it to a parent choice is done afterwards in choice-linking.
